successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Agadez and the Aïr massif (the page gives no extent)

ledger.x: c. 1405: local Tuareg tribes found the Sultanate of Agadez in the Aïr. "Oral history of the Aïr describes the foundation of the sultanate around 1405 by local Tuareg tribes"; infobox "Establishment of the Sultanate: 1405".

c. 1516-7: Songhai conquers Agadez. "The Agadez Sultanate was later conquered by the Songhai Empire in 1500"; "Circa 1516-7 the Songhai Empire successfully campaigned against Agadez". The Songhai dossier dates the gain to 1515.
1906: the Sultanate of Agadez ends as a sovereign state; it continues as a non-sovereign monarchy within Niger.

wars.name: Songhai conquest of Agadez
wars.outcome: "Conquered by the Songhai Empire in 1500" or in a campaign c.

certainty.note: The page gives no extent; the sultanate's reach over the Tuareg confederacies of the Aïr is not outlined.
